Production sprite sheet for the existing small WeChat village game. The supplied APPROVED CHARACTER BOARD is the strict identity, clothing and color reference. This is a real GAME ANIMATION ASSET, not another concept board.
TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. NO labels, text, borders, grid lines, beige background, floor, ground marks, drop shadows, glow, particles or scenery. Mild overhead 3/4 camera consistent with reference. Friendly compact Chinese village chibi, large readable flat color clusters with dark brown outlines, 2-3 shade levels, no fine texture. Must be readable when nearest-neighbor reduced to 80x80 cells (64x64 children).
Exact uniform grid spanning the FULL canvas, every cell exactly the same size. One complete isolated whole-body sprite centered in each cell. Cells have 10% left/right empty gutters; feet/cane rest near 93% of each cell height. Body ground position is FIXED within every cell: animation is IN PLACE. The SAME height, costume, hair, head scale, foot ground baseline and camera across frames of one identity. Never normalize individual poses to fill a cell. No overlap between cells, no cut-off tools or hair. Each loop must contain visibly DIFFERENT motion poses; do not repeat one static image.
A 4-frame walk cycle in each row is: frame 1 left foot contact / right foot raised, frame 2 passing pose with feet near body, frame 3 right foot contact / left foot raised, frame 4 opposite passing pose. Opposing arms swing, small body bob only. In front and back rows, make the two contact poses visibly extend OPPOSITE feet. Side rows face SCREEN RIGHT, with a wide step in contact frames and narrow feet in passing frames.
Adult MAN: short tousled charcoal blue-black hair, NO bun, indigo-blue wrap shirt with narrow pale-blue collar/cuffs, slate navy trousers, brown cloth shoes. Blue shirt is a substantial mid-value blue area, not nearly black.
Adult WOMAN: chestnut single LONG thick braid behind shoulder/back, no top bun, warm orange/terracotta wrap blouse, apricot narrow collar/cuffs, brick-red A-line working skirt, brown shoes. Braid stays attached and consistent in all poses. Simple costume identical to approved board.
Children are separately specified where needed. Preserve warm natural skin tone for everyone.

Row 6: adult WOMAN SIDE / RIGHT four-frame walking, nose and toes point right.
Twenty-four sprites, exact row order. Torso height and foot baseline must remain consistent across all six rows. Do not draw a spear, staff or work tool.
